summary: Learn to calculate safety rates, assess leading indicators, and build practical reporting outputs. Explore the 5-day course and enrol.
lede: Communicating occupational safety metrics means turning incident, hazard, and control data into clear findings for people outside safety teams. The course is for safety officers, OHS managers, investigators, analysts, and reporting specialists who prepare performance updates and action reports. Participants practise defining and checking indicators, calculating injury rates, interpreting trends, verifying controls, and presenting findings with clear caveats and action ownership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, analyse, verify, or report occupational safety performance information.
modules: OHS KPI Definitions and Data Quality
Hierarchy of Controls and Bow-Tie Analysis
Excel and Power BI Safety Dashboards
prerequisites: Prior familiarity with workplace safety management, incident records, or OHS reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the calculation exercises; Power BI dashboard design is covered as a practical specification activity, and no Power BI installation is required.
